Class CannonProjectile

java.lang.Object
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.entities.Entity
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.entities.Projectile
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.entities.CannonProjectile
Direct Known Subclasses:
J2dCannonProjectile
public abstract class CannonProjectile extends Projectile
Abstract projectile fired by the CannonTower.

On impact it deals direct damage to its primary target and splash damage to every other alive enemy within splashRadius of the impact point.

The splash logic lives here in onHit(Enemy, List) — not in the game loop. This keeps the game loop free of projectile-type-specific code: it simply calls projectile.onHit(target, enemies) and the right behaviour is selected polymorphically.

The projectile intentionally holds no reference to the firing tower — only the splash stats it needs. This preserves the decoupling described in Projectile: a projectile can outlive the situation that created it without dangling references.

J2dCannonProjectile extends this class and implements render().

      public CannonProjectile(Position startPosition, Position targetPosition, double speed, int damage, double splashRadius, int splashDamage)
      Creates a cannon projectile with both direct and splash damage stats.
      Parameters:
      startPosition - the position the projectile is fired from
      targetPosition - the fixed world position the projectile flies toward
      speed - the travel speed in game-world units per second
      damage - the direct damage dealt to the primary target
      splashRadius - the radius around the impact point in which splash applies
      splashDamage - the damage applied to other enemies within the splash radius
